checks.rule_text: Bun is the package manager. Never use npm, pnpm, yarn or npx; use `bun add` / `bunx`.
checks.statement: Did the session run npm, pnpm, yarn or npx as a command instead of bun/bunx?
checks.message: This project uses Bun. Use `bun add` / `bunx` instead of npm, pnpm, yarn or npx.

should_not_match: bun run typecheck && bun run lint

checks.rule_text: Never run `gh auth switch`. It changes the account for the whole machine.
checks.statement: Did the session run `gh auth switch`?
checks.message: `gh auth switch` changes the account machine-wide and breaks parallel sessions. Use the per-command GH_TOKEN prefix.
examples_negative: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh pr list

should_not_match: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh pr list

checks.rule_text: Prefix every `gh` call with a per-command token: `GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh ...`.
checks.statement: Did a `gh` command run without the GH_TOKEN per-command prefix?
checks.message: Prefix gh calls with GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) so the right account is used.
examples_negative: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh pr create --fill

should_not_match: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh pr list

checks.rule_text: `bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run audit` must pass before any commit.
checks.statement: Was a git commit made with no prior run of the quality gate?
checks.message: Run the quality gate (typecheck, lint, format:check, test, audit) before committing.
examples_positive: Bash git commit -m 'feat: add post list'
examples_negative:
Bash bun run typecheck && bun run lint
Bash git commit -m 'feat: add post list'

should_match: Bash git commit -m 'feat: add post list'
should_not_match:
Bash bun run typecheck && bun run lint
Bash git commit -m 'feat: add post list'

checks.rule_text: Schema change: edit `packages/db/src/schema.ts`, then `bun run db:generate` and commit the new migration.
checks.statement: Was the Drizzle schema edited without `bun run db:generate` running afterwards?
checks.message: After editing packages/db/src/schema.ts run `bun run db:generate` and commit the migration.

checks.rule_text: `packages/db` is imported only by `apps/api`; the admin panel never reads the DB and calls the API only.
checks.statement: Does a file outside apps/api import @acme/db?
checks.message: Only apps/api may import @acme/db. Call the API through @acme/api-client instead.

checks.rule_text: `packages/shared` holds zod schemas, enums, permissions and limits. No React, no DB code.
checks.statement: Does a file in packages/shared import React?
checks.message: packages/shared must stay framework-free: no React imports.

should_not_match:
import { z } from 'zod'
// import React from 'react'

checks.rule_ref: The docs are a wiki (Karpathy LLM wiki pattern)
checks.rule_text: `docs/raw/` is immutable input. Add files, never edit them.
checks.statement: Did the session edit an existing file under docs/raw/?
checks.message: docs/raw/ is immutable. Add a new source file instead of editing an existing one.

checks.rule_ref: When to write an ADR (every session, including implementation)
checks.rule_text: After writing an ADR, add the line under "Decisions" in `docs/index.md`.
checks.statement: Was a new ADR written without docs/index.md being updated in the same session?
checks.message: A new ADR needs its line under "Decisions" in docs/index.md in the same change.

checks.rule_ref: When to write an ADR (every session, including implementation)
checks.rule_text: After writing an ADR, add a `decision` entry in `docs/log.md`.
checks.statement: Was a new ADR written without a decision entry being added to docs/log.md?
checks.message: A new ADR needs a `decision` entry appended to docs/log.md.

checks.rule_ref: When to write an ADR (every session, including implementation)
checks.rule_text: Write `docs/adr/NNNN-<kebab>.md` (next free number).
checks.statement: Was a file written under docs/adr/ whose name is not NNNN-kebab-case.md?
checks.message: ADR files are named docs/adr/NNNN-<kebab>.md with a four-digit number.

checks.rule_ref: When to write an ADR (every session, including implementation)
checks.rule_text: ADR template includes `## Alternatives rejected` (one-line reason each).

checks.message: The ADR template requires an `## Alternatives rejected` section.

checks.rule_ref: The docs are a wiki (Karpathy LLM wiki pattern)
checks.rule_text: `docs/index.md` lists every docs file. Any page you create or rename gets a line there in the same change.
checks.statement: Was a new docs page created without docs/index.md being updated?
checks.message: Every new docs page needs a one-line entry in docs/index.md in the same change.

checks.rule_text: `master` takes code only through a PR with green CI.
checks.statement: Did the session push directly to master?
checks.message: master is protected: land code through a PR with green CI, never a direct push.

checks.message: Tick shipped stories in the GitHub issue, not in the stories spec file.
examples_positive: - [x] US-012 Admin can delete a post

checks.rule_text: Plan with `/prd-to-plan` for anything that touches auth, permissions, the DB schema, or more than 3 files.
checks.statement: Was the DB schema edited without /prd-to-plan having been invoked first?
checks.message: Schema changes need a /prd-to-plan plan before the edit.

checks.rule_ref: Specs are the source of truth
checks.rule_text: Read `docs/index.md` first, then only the pages the task needs.
checks.statement: Was a docs page read before docs/index.md had been read?
checks.message: Read docs/index.md first, then only the pages the task needs.

checks.rule_text: Every API input is validated with a zod schema from `@acme/shared`. Only exception: the Better Auth handler.
checks.statement: Does an API route added or changed here accept input without validating it against a zod schema from @acme/shared?
checks.message: API input must be validated with a zod schema from @acme/shared.
examples_positive: app.post('/posts', async (c) => { const body = await c.req.json(); return c.json(await createPost(body)) })

checks.rule_text: Authorization lives in the API, per `docs/specs/permissions.md`. UI hiding is not authorization.
checks.statement: Was an authorization decision implemented only by hiding UI, with no corresponding API-side check?
checks.message: Authorization belongs in the API; hiding UI is not a permission check.
examples_positive: {user.role === 'admin' && <DeleteButton />}  // with no server-side role check added

checks.rule_text: The API returns response schemas per role, never raw DB rows.
checks.statement: Does an API handler return a raw database row instead of a per-role response schema?
checks.message: Return a per-role response schema, never a raw DB row.

checks.rule_text: No secrets in code or logs. Use env vars.
checks.statement: Was a secret value hard-coded in source or written into a log line?
checks.message: Secrets belong in env vars, never in code or log output.

checks.rule_ref: When to write an ADR (every session, including implementation)
checks.rule_text: Write an ADR in the same session when you chose between options, rejected something expected, added a constraint the specs don't state, or worked around a platform limitation.
checks.statement: Did the session make a decision of a kind the ADR rule lists without writing an ADR for it?
checks.message: A decision of this kind needs an ADR in the same session or PR.
examples_positive: Picked pg-boss over BullMQ in passing and shipped it with no docs/adr/ entry.
examples_negative: Picked pg-boss over BullMQ and wrote docs/adr/0064-job-queue-choice.md in the same session.
Followed the queue choice already fixed by docs/specs/architecture.md and cited that file.

checks.rule_ref: The docs are a wiki (Karpathy LLM wiki pattern)
checks.rule_text: Ingest and lint are human-triggered; never rewrite docs in bulk on your own.
checks.statement: Did the session rewrite documentation in bulk without being asked to?
checks.message: Do not rewrite docs in bulk unprompted; ingest and lint are human-triggered.
examples_positive: Rewrote every page under docs/specs/ for tone, unprompted.
examples_negative: Updated the one spec page the task changed.
Ran /wiki-ingest because the user asked for it.

checks.rule_ref: The docs are a wiki (Karpathy LLM wiki pattern)
checks.rule_text: A new source that contradicts an existing page: stop and ask which wins. Never resolve silently.
checks.statement: Did the session resolve a contradiction between a new source and an existing page without asking the user?
checks.message: Stop and ask when a new source contradicts an existing page.
examples_positive: Noticed the new brief contradicts docs/specs/permissions.md and silently updated the page.
examples_negative: Noticed the contradiction and asked the user which source wins before editing.

checks.rule_ref: Specs are the source of truth
checks.rule_text: Don't re-explain context the docs already hold; ask `/wiki-query` instead.
checks.statement: Did the response re-explain project context that the docs already hold?
checks.message: Cite the docs rather than restating context they already hold.
examples_positive: Restated the whole permissions model in chat instead of citing docs/specs/permissions.md.
examples_negative: Cited docs/specs/permissions.md and answered only the question asked.

checks.rule_text: Write the failing test first, see it fail, then the code.
checks.statement: Was implementation code written before a failing test existed for it?
checks.message: Write the failing test first and see it fail before the implementation.
examples_positive: Implemented the new endpoint, then added a passing test afterwards.
examples_negative: Wrote the failing test, ran it red, then implemented the endpoint.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Specs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: `docs/specs/` wins over code. When they disagree, fix one explicitly, never silently.
not_checkable.why: Detecting that a spec and the code disagree needs cross-file semantic comparison the checker cannot do.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Specs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: Read only the pages the task needs.
not_checkable.why: "Needed" is relative to a task the checker cannot scope; any read set is defensible.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Specs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: Before any feature change, read its `docs/specs/features/<slug>.md`; with no spec, write it with `/feature-spec` and stop for approval.
not_checkable.why: Nothing in the corpora identifies which edits constitute a "feature change" or which slug belongs to them.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Specs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: Story ids are permanent, never renumber.
not_checkable.why: Renumbering is a diff-level semantic comparison of ids across versions; the net diff does not expose the prior numbering.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Specs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: A role x action missing from `docs/specs/permissions.md` is denied.
not_checkable.why: Requires resolving the permissions table against every call site - cross-file reasoning the checker cannot do.

not_checkable.rule_text: Stop `bun run dev` before `bun run test:e2e`; check ports 3100/3101.
not_checkable.why: Whether a dev server was running is machine state, not anything in the transcript.

not_checkable.rule_text: `bun run test` needs `docker compose up -d`.
not_checkable.why: A session on an already-running stack is compliant, and the checker cannot see that the containers were up.

not_checkable.rule_text: Command reference: dev, e2e, single-package test, psql, local stack ports.
not_checkable.why: Descriptive invocation reference, not an obligation with a failure signature.

not_checkable.rule_text: App and panel call the API only through `@acme/api-client`.
not_checkable.why: Catching a raw fetch needs call-graph context; a character pattern over hunks would accuse ordinary fetch use.

not_checkable.rule_text: Repo layout: entry points, route locations, package responsibilities.
not_checkable.why: Descriptive layout, no detectable failure signature.

not_checkable.rule_text: Per-app rules load from `.claude/rules/` when you touch matching files.
not_checkable.why: Describes harness behaviour, not an action the agent can get wrong.

not_checkable.rule_text: Update the app's `.env.example` when you add an env var.
not_checkable.why: The trigger is adding an env var, which is visible only inside string literals the checker strips before matching.

not_checkable.rule_text: No string-built SQL. Use the Drizzle query builder.
not_checkable.why: String literals are stripped before any pattern runs, so SQL text inside a string can never be matched.

not_checkable.rule_text: No UI text in code: Polish strings go in the app's i18next files.
not_checkable.why: Same reason: the UI strings this rule is about live inside string literals, which are stripped before matching.

not_checkable.rule_text: Fresh session per issue; spec, /prd-to-plan, /implement-plan-workflow, review, PR.
not_checkable.why: Session boundaries are not in the corpus, and the phase sequence spans sessions.

not_checkable.rule_text: Before you plan a feature, read `.claude/rules/<app>.md` for every app it touches.
not_checkable.why: Which apps a feature touches is not derivable before the edits exist.

not_checkable.rule_text: A bug the next feature could repeat gets a line in `.claude/review-checklist.md` in the PR that fixes it.
not_checkable.why: Deciding which fixes are repeatable bug classes is a judgement with no enumerable site.

not_checkable.rule_text: Before a PR, run the security + performance review from `docs/WORKFLOW.md` Step 8.
not_checkable.why: The review is prose work with no command or tool call that marks it as having happened.

not_checkable.rule_ref: When to write an ADR (every session, including implementation)
not_checkable.rule_text: Skip the ADR when architecture.md, data-model.md, permissions.md or an existing ADR already dictates the choice; cite that file instead.
not_checkable.why: An exception clause to another rule; it has no independent failure signature.

not_checkable.rule_ref: The docs are a wiki (Karpathy LLM wiki pattern)
not_checkable.rule_text: `docs/log.md` is append-only: `## [YYYY-MM-DD] <ingest|decision|lint|query> | <what> -> <files>`.
not_checkable.why: Append-only means prior lines are unchanged, which the net diff cannot establish.
